verified_details: Separate randomized booster versus treatment-as-usual assignment.
Clinical assessors and Rush video annotators blinded; participants and live tic coders could not be blinded.
Analysis plan limited inclusion to participants completing six training sessions.
Registration was described as prior to analysis; not demonstrably prior to enrollment.
